messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

After the Expense Report is received, a new account must be created if the employee does not already have one. The report is then reviewed for automatic approval. Amounts under $200 are automatically approved, whereas amounts equal to or over $200 require approval of the supervisor. In case of rejection, the employee must receive a rejection notice by email. Otherwise, the reimbursement goes to the employees direct deposit bank account. If the request is not completed in 7 days, then the employee must receive an approval in progress email. If the request is not finished within 30 days, then the process is stopped and the employee receives an email cancellation notice and must re-submit the expense report.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_ExpenseProcess" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="ExpenseReportProcess" name="Expense Report Process" isExecutable="true">

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckAccount" name="Employee Has Account?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAccount" name="Create New Account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountCreated</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckAmount" name="Check Amount">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountCreated</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AutoApprove</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SupervisorApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AutoApprove" name="Automatic Approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AutoApprove</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToReimburse</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SupervisorApproval" name="Supervisor Approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SupervisorApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_7Days" name="7 Days Elapsed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SupervisorApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendProgressEmail</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendProgressEmail" name="Send 'Approval in Progress' Email">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendProgressEmail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BackToApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_30Days" name="30 Days Elapsed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SupervisorApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CancelProcess</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendCancellationEmail" name="Send Cancellation Notice Email">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CancelProcess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EndCancelled</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Cancelled" name="Process Cancelled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EndCancelled</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRejectionEmail" name="Send Rejection Notice Email">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EndRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Rejected">

    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process Direct Deposit Reimbursement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToReimburse</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EndCompleted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Reimbursement Completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EndCompleted</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_Received" targetRef="Gateway_CheckAccount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckAccount" targetRef="Task_CreateAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${!hasAccount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasAccount" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${hasAccount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountCreated" sourceRef="Task_CreateAccount" targetRef="Gateway_CheckAmount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutoApprove" name="< $200" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckAmount" targetRef="Task_AutoApprove">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${amount < 200}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SupervisorApproval" name=">= $200" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckAmount" targetRef="Task_SupervisorApproval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${amount >= 200}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToReimburse" sourceRef="Task_AutoApprove" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Task_SupervisorApproval" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${decision == 'approved'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Task_SupervisorApproval" targetRef="Task_SendRejectionEmail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${decision == 'rejected'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendProgressEmail" sourceRef="Timer_7Days" targetRef="Task_SendProgressEmail" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BackToApproval" sourceRef="Task_SendProgressEmail" targetRef="Task_SupervisorApproval" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CancelProcess" sourceRef="Timer_30Days" targetRef="Task_SendCancellationEmail" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndCancelled" sourceRef="Task_SendCancellationEmail" targetRef="EndEvent_Cancelled" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndRejected" sourceRef="Task_SendRejectionEmail" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndCompleted" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed" />
  </bpmn:process>
